weighting_contract: Bake exactly ONE current source default skinned surface into canonical POSITION/NORMAL streams; preserve indices/UVs/materialgroups/maps. Original model bytes remain separate and untouched.

Build a new independent four-limb26joint hierarchy with inversebinds at these reviewed source-specific pivots; neutral worldjoint×inversebind=identity preserves the frozen rest surface for any normalized weights.
Assign matching material seam vertices the same weights using canonicalposition classes; do not create weighted cracks at color/UV boundaries.
Rigidly bind original annotated lower-hoof regions to their own new hoofbone; blend adjacent fetlock/cannon segments with at most4 normalized influences and explicitly isolate the four limbs.
Blend proximal regions into body and neck/head/tail by reconstructed capsule control volumes. Do not transfer original malformed serial-chain weights or old89b joint indices.
Keep default source surface visible. Prove actual decoded neutral surface/UV/indices/material/image parity, weight sums/indices, then loaded skin across extrema before app intake.

motion_contract.phase_driver: travelled_distance_m/explicit_authored_stride_m, not free wallclock or staticmesh translation
motion_contract.planned_foot_targets: Source-reference cycle footpath shapes retargeted through NEW hostchain IK; all stance targets are fixed in world-space against actual drawn route ground. Donor authored phase/contact must be measured before calibration.
motion_contract.start_stop_turning: Must have explicit new finite entrance/exit/turning target/contact proof; legacy finite-player clock/lifecycle methodology may be reused, not its oldbone clips/sockets.
